items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Had Benny Waters -- Benny Waters, again, on Tenor; Una Mae Carlisle, piano;

ctx.x: No, I wasn't -- no. They took me down to 802 and got me a card and put me in the union, and back that time -- so it was easy. I was a union man. I was in the union, I had an 802 card in my pocket, and a job.

So everything was fine, and Charlie had a doggone good band, you know. He had Benny Waters on Tenor sax. He had Johnson -- Bobbie Johnson on guitar. He had -- uh, uh -- I'm trying to -- he had Bobbie Johnson's brother on sax -- let's see, what's his name? Gooseneck, we used to call him.
